profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer, Technology Leader, and UI Specialist
profile.summary:
An accomplished technology leader with over 20 years of experience in software engineering, I am currently in an engineering leadership position that enables me to leverage my extensive expertise in building high-quality, data-driven products. With a strong background in computer science and applied mathematics, I am skilled in a wide range of web technologies, including HTML5, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Angular, NodeJS, and more.

As a Master of Science candidate in Computer Science with a concentration in Machine Learning at Georgia Institute of Technology, I bring a unique blend of academic and practical knowledge to the table. I've excelled in agile environments, applying SCRUM, KanBan methodologies, and using tools such as Jira and Asana. My experience also includes managing developer mentoring, code reviews, UX design, wireframes, mockups, and technical documentation.

Throughout my career, I have made significant contributions to the success of industry-leading companies such as Stitch Fix, Inc., Amobee, Inc., and Cisco Systems, Inc. I have consistently demonstrated the ability to lead and guide teams, delivering innovative solutions in domains like retail technology, advertising technology, and enterprise network security.

At Stitch Fix, I played a pivotal role in enhancing the proficiency, effectiveness, and delivery of advanced frontend solutions for the Buying Experience product delivery team. My work has resulted in increased customer retention, decreased cart abandonment rates, and the modernization of micro-frontend React applications.

In my role at Amobee, I led the UI Platform team, coordinating work with key stakeholders and overseeing the development of design systems and component libraries for multiple distributed teams. At Cisco Systems, I developed user-friendly interfaces for network security and mitigation, applying my extensive expertise in client-side programming.

I am highly motivated and passionate about making a significant impact in my next role. My proven track record in web development, team leadership, and problem-solving make me an ideal candidate for any organization that values quality, innovation, and collaboration.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description: In the pivotal role of Principal Engineer within the Merchandising IT division, I don't just oversee - I elevate. Leveraging expert-level knowledge, I chart a visionary course for the technical execution and delivery of large-scale, transformative projects. My influence extends to the nuanced architecture and strategic development of over 45 UI applications. I am the trusted mentor and guide for 10 high-performing delivery teams, fostering innovation and ensuring alignment with the division wide UI Architecture strategy which I crafted within 1 month of onboarding. With the responsibility of leading a dynamic department of over 80 dedicated engineers, I've transformed challenges into accomplishments, ensuring that our technological solutions don't just meet industry standards, but set them.

positions.title: CEO and Principal Developer
positions.description:
Crafting unique mobile application solutions for startups using React Native and No-Code to Low-Code platforms that allow clients across a broad range of industries to test and validate concepts for scale. Analyze and create architectural solutions that reflect knowledge of multiple platform architectures and performance implications, based on business requirements. Design & develop unique mobile user experiences that allow for build, measure, and learn feedback loops. Develop API and database solutions that interface with No-Code Platforms to provide a Backend as a Service. Ensure quality assurance across the mobile app experience through beta testing and tester feedback loops. Work with clients on product development, launch strategy, and brand identity.

Javascript, TypeScript, React Native, Node.js, Webpack, Google Cloud Platform, Google Cloud Services, WebFlow, Figma, Adobe Photoshop/Illustrator, Sales Strategy, Marketing Strategy, Brand Strategy, Product Development

positions.title: Principal Engineer
positions.description:
Domain: Retail Technology

Overall Impact: Increased best practices, code quality, proficiency, effectiveness, delivery, and performance of advanced & complex frontend solutions for the Buying Experience product delivery team of seven mid-level to senior full-stack Ruby engineers, across five micro-frontend architectures and over ten micro-service architectures.

•Led updates to modernize micro-frontend React applications and create plans for new platform solutions for the lower funnel Buying Experience. Updates included migrations to Typescript and anew frontend only stack using NextJS and graphQL from Rails.  
•Evangelized JavaScript/Typescript and React development best practices and set exceptional standards for the team through code reviews, pair programming, and technical discussions.
•Collaborated with upper management, Product Management, Design, and other cross functional teams to deﬁne and deliver on our domain’s product and technical roadmap through and iterative and agile software delivery process.
•Closely monitored performance and business metrics of all production applications in the Buying Experience domain to make data driven analysis and decisions on critical feature development to increase customer retention and spending.
•Provided mentorship to team engineers giving informal feedback on their strengths and weaknesses as well as coaching on their career progression.
•Lead feature development projects including writing PRDs, Risk Analysis, Task break down and delegation
•Diagnose complex customer issues and take ownership of issue resolution
•Be available as needed for on-call rotation to monitor production site reliability. Triage and resolve any arising issues and anomalies resulting from failed jobs, containers, or spikes in abnormal activity as primary on-call resource.

positions.title: Lead UI Engineer
positions.description:
Domain: Enterprise Advertising Technology (AdTech)

Lead and guide UI Platform team members in the implementation and execution of UI Platform projects. Oversee day-to-day, hands-on development across projects based on an advanced skill level in client-side programming; Work with key product stake holders, Engineering Directors and VP of Engineering to coordinate work and delivery of design systems and component libraries to multiple distributed teams. Created architectural solutions that reflect clear knowledge of application architecture in multiple stacks, and domain subject matters; Maintained a high level of internal customer service that is prompt, responsive, courteous, and comprehensive; Maintained working relationships that facilitate the positive outcome of program objectives and product roadmap. Defined and documented standards and best practices for coding style, conventions, and development frameworks. Ensured quality assurance practices were implemented and met across all UI component libraries distributed to development teams. Fostered team member growth and independence. Managed team by ensuring each team member is individually set up for success in their role.
